description:
This protocol automates the filling of a specialized 384-well (rotated 90 degrees and takes up two slots). Using a 96-well plate containing the reagents, the p20 will aspirate 20µL from the 96-well plate and dispense 10µL into the 384-well plate, swapping tips each time the the p20 moves to another column (different reagents) until the 384-well plate is filled.

If you have any questions about this protocol, please email our Applications Engineering team at protocols@opentrons.com.


To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our online store or contact our sales team at info@opentrons.com

Opentrons OT-2
Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 3.19.0 or later)
Opentrons p20 Multi-Channel Pipette (attached to right mount)
Opentrons 20µL Tip Rack
NEST 96-Well PCR Plate
384-Well Plate with Custom Adapter



Deck Layout

Slot 1: Opentrons 20µL Tip Rack

Slot 5: NEST 96-Well PCR Plate
Reagent Locations
 Reagent 1: B1 (40µL), H11 (160µL), and H12 (160µL)
 Reagent 2: B2 (40µL), G11 (160µL), and G12 (160µL)
 Reagent 3: A1 (40µL), F11 (160µL), and F12 (160µL)
 Reagent 4: B3 (40µL), E11 (160µL), and E12 (160µL)
 Reagent 5: B4 (40µL), D11 (160µL), and D12 (160µL)
 Reagent 6: A3 (40µL), C11 (160µL), and C12 (160µL)
 Reagent 7: B6 (40µL), B11 (160µL), and B12 (160µL)
 Reagent 8: B5 (40µL), A11 (160µL), and A12 (160µL)
 Reagent 9: D1-D8 + B8 (40µL)
 Reagent 10: C1-C8 + B7 (40µL)

Slot 3/6: 384-Well Plate with Custom Adapter
